item.title: EP Wealth Acquires $218 Million Firm Clearview
item.description: EP Wealth Advisors has acquired Clearview Wealth Advisors, a planning focused registered investment advisory firm serving clients across the Pacific Northwest and the Phoenix metropolitan area, as EP Wealth continues expanding its national footprint through strategic partnerships. EP Wealth said the deal adds nearly $218 million in assets under management and brings the Clearview team into EP Wealth’s Phoenix region, where it will gain access to expanded planning, tax and investment resources. item.title: Verisoul: $8.8 Million Series A Closed To Counter AI Driven Fraud And Fake Users
item.description: Verisoul has raised an $8.8 million Series A round to expand its fraud prevention platform focused on stopping fake accounts, bots, and other forms of user-driven abuse as AI makes attacks more scalable and harder to detect. The round was led by High Alpha, with participation from Lookout Ventures, Bain Future Back Ventures, Bitkraf,t and Third Prime. item.title: MoEngage Adds $180 Million To Series F, Bringing Total Raise To $280 Million
item.description: MoEngage has raised an additional $180 million as part of its Series F financing, bringing the total Series F capital raised to $280 million following a $100 million investment announced in November 2025. The latest round was led by new investors ChrysCapital and Dragon Funds, alongside Schroders Capital, with continued participation from existing investors TR Capital and B Capital. item.title: Scylos: $3 Million Seed Funding Raised To Build Stateless Endpoint Infrastructure
item.description: Scylos has raised a $3 million oversubscribed seed financing round to accelerate development of its stateless endpoint infrastructure platform and expand pilots across enterprise and public sector environments where uptime, security, and compliance requirements are high. The funding round was led by Galgano family investments, with participation from multiple private investors. item.title: DNA Nanobots: $3.5 Million Closed From Family Office To Advance Non Viral Gene Therapy Platform And Extend Runway
item.description: DNA Nanobots has secured a $3.5 million investment from a prominent family office as it works to advance a non viral gene delivery platform built around self assembling nanoscale therapeutics. The Columbus, Ohio based company said the funding extends its operational runway for the next 18 months and will support continued development of its programmable gene delivery technology. item.title: HEN Technologies: $22 Million Raised To Build AI Driven Fire Defense Operating System
item.description: HEN Technologies has secured $22 million in new financing, closing an oversubscribed $20 million Series A round alongside $2 million in venture debt, as it accelerates development of what it describes as the industry’s first operating system for fire defense. The Hayward, California-based company said the funding will speed the deployment of Fluid IQ, its predictive AI platform built on advanced fluid-dynamics hardware, and bring its total capital raised to more than $30 million. item.title: Tebra: $250 Million Funding Raised To Accelerate AI Across EHR, Billing Automation And Practice Marketing
item.description: Tebra has closed $250 million in new equity and debt financing to accelerate research and development in AI and automation for independent healthcare practices. The Newport Beach, California-based company said the oversubscribed round will fund expanded AI-powered capabilities across clinical documentation, billing and payments, patient experience, and practice marketing for its EHR+ platform, which it says is used by more than 140,000 private healthcare providers. item.title: CleanCapital: $185 Million Private Placement Debt Deal Closed To Finance Distributed Solar And Storage Portfolio
item.description: CleanCapital has completed a $185 million private placement debt issuance to what it described as top U.S. investors, securing long term financing flexibility to support a growing portfolio of distributed generation solar and energy storage projects. The New York based independent power producer said the facility initially comprises 156 projects totaling more than 180 megawatts and is structured to scale through additional tranches over time.
